text: Hello everyone, welcome to my class.In the previous lessons, we finished the reading and interaction section.Today, we are going to start a new section, Grammar Activity, the Subject Clause.By the end of this period, you are expected to accurately identify different types of subject clauses in the given context.And you are also expected to use the subject clause to talk about environmental issues.Moreover, you are expected to raise environmental awareness by reflecting on your daily habits.Before starting, please make sure your textbook and the worksheet are at hand.It is interesting that some people are obsessed with holding things, while others often leave things behind when they leave a certain place.Take travelers as an example, they often leave things in hotels they stay.Have you ever left anything in a hotel room?What I once left in a hotel room is my mobile phone charger.Actually, it is sad that over 70% of travelers who return from their holidays find something missing when they unpack their bags.Besides some common items, some travelers may leave behind some strange things.Now, please open the textbook and turn to page 36.Today, we are going to read a passage about some left-behind items.Don't forget your toothbrush.While reading, please find the answers to the following questions.You may underline the evidence in the passage, and you will have two minutes.Time is up.Let's check the answers.第一,70%的旅客回家後,把袋子包起來,然後找出一些缺失的東西。第二,不,當他們清理房間時,通常也不值得報告或保護。第三,因為很多旅客只在急著離開,其他旅客在第一天會帶太多東西。所以,為什麼我們很多人會忘記一些東西,大或小,可能是因為幾個很常見的因素。第四,那些小的東西,當它們離開後,也不應該讓任何人感到驚訝。現在,我們專注在這四個文字上。看看每個文字上的下方。它們的功能是什麼?是的,它們的功能是主題。所以,我們稱它們為主題文字,也就是主題文字。主題文字的一個功能是,它把某個文字的資訊放在主題的位置,然後把新的資訊放在後面,讓讀者專注在其中。例如,在第一句中,什麼連結文字可以用來介紹主題文字?是的,什麼連結文字可以用來介紹主題文字?在哪個單位中,主題文字會有什麼連結文字?是的,主題文字會有什麼連結文字?然後,現在,再次讀出這四個文字,並回答這四個問題。第一,什麼連結文字會有什麼連結文字?第二,什麼連結文字可以用來介紹主題文字?你會有一分鐘。第三,什麼連結文字會有什麼連結文字?在哪個單位中?现在,让我们检查答题。第一个问题,关于天气的连接词,用于两种可能性来谈论。第一种可能性是,天气的连接词,用于两种可能性来谈论。第一种可能性是,富裕的贵物,另一种可能性是,商业旅客的手机货。然而,天气的连接词,用于两种可能性来谈论。第二种可能性是,天气的连接词,用于两种可能性来谈论。第二种可能性是,富裕的贵物,用于两种可能性来谈论。第三种可能性是,天气的连接词,用于两种可能性来谈论。我们可以发现,这个词中,主题词是很长的。为了平衡一个词,用一个长的主题词,我们可以把词放在另一种方式。这里,它是预测的主题,形式主语,并代表主题词,被天气介绍的主题词。词中的实际主题词是,富裕的贵物,用于两种可能性来谈论。富裕的贵物,用于两种可能性来谈论。我们可以把词放在两种方式,因为两种词词都很合理。现在,您可以用它作为预测的主题词,来平衡这个词吗?对,它似乎很常见,人们在他们留的地方都会忘了一些东西。这里,它代表人们在他们留的地方都会忘了一些东西。现在,您将有下一个15秒,来评论三个主题词的规则,您刚刚学到的。现在,请试图完成这些主题词,对,那,什么,或是什么样的。您将有下一个1分钟。【转换系列】我们来查查答案第一But the fact that something needs to be done to clean up our beaches is obvious to everyone.Here, the linking word that is used to introduce a fact that something needs to be done to clean up our beaches.It is a shame that more people don't make an effort to clean up our beaches and oceans.Here, the subject clause introduced by that is quite long, so we may use it as the anticipatory subject to balance the sentence.What we need to do is to make sure that nothing is left behind before we check out of the hotel.Here, we use the linking word what because in the subject clause, an object is missing.Whether you dropped something or someone else dropped it doesn't matter.If you see it, pick it up.The linking word whether is used to introduce a subject clause when we talk about two possibilities.In this subject clause, one possibility is you dropped something and the other is someone else dropped something.After reading the passage, we have come to realize that not only do we need to make sure that nothing is left behind before we leave the hotels, but also we should care for animals like the fish mentioned in the passage which shouldn't have been left behind in a bath.In other words, we need to be responsible travelers because whether we choose to be a responsible traveler or not will make a big difference to our environment.Look at these three pictures reflecting the irresponsible behavior of travelers.Use at least two subject clauses to describe the phenomenon reflected in the pictures.You may refer to the following structures.Take picture one as an example.What do you think about travelers' littering?Why do they litter?For me, I think it is a shame and they litter because they lack environmental awareness.So we can say it is a shame that travelers litter.Why they litter may be due to their lack of environmental awareness.Now you will have two minutes to write down at least two sentences for each picture.Thank you for watching this video.Good job.We have only one Earth.It is our responsibility to leave the world a better place for future generations.Here comes today's homework.Thanks for watching.See you next time.
